text: Don't be fooled by the misleading adverts. Yes, the puzzles exist but they are locked by leveling in the battle strategy part of the game. You'll get maybe five minutes of mediocre puzzles for every hour of mediocre PvP strategy game. EDIT - developer response is the same stock message to about half the reviews on here. I didn't say the advertised content wasn't in the game, just that the vast majority of the game you'll actually be playing isn't shown at all in the ads.

Clearly development and progression in this game is for the wealthy and those that don't mind wasting their money. I give it one star as its visuals are pretty good. But at the end of the day it'll end up like other games of this genre, empty. That's after the game numbers go through the roof and you're talking billions of troops, billions even trillions of resources to be able to do anything. They'll be Dragons, Demigods and probably the next upgrade to Lvl 50 buildings. IMO, save your money.

I downloaded due to the puzzles being advertised but it's not a puzzle game, it's a strategic war game essentially. I gave it a go, and started to like it, but started getting passive-aggressive messages in my "mailbox" basically saying join an alliance or else. The other players chat (in "world chat") can be quite emotive with swearing. Other people seem to enjoy the game so maybe it's me being "tagless". Not for the casual player.

As others have said, the game is not based around the puzzles advertised. They exist in the game but as soon as I started having to build things, which will inevitably lead to me spending money to speed them up, I uninstalled. Developer advertising one thing and the game being another. All I want is to play a puzzle game while taking a dump in peace and not be used as a cash cow in the process.

Don't bother! Very poor customer support, emails go unanswered and in game support simply ignored. Lost my account following update, after many hours playing and unable to recover original game profile. Seems a common issue, appear more interested in what they can make from the players rather than looking after them. Try logging into the forum first, and that should give you some idea of what you could be dealing with if things go wrong!

Was quite disappointed with the game, it's just very boring. The ads show it as a puzzle game, but it's mostly another gathering game :/. Yea it has puzzles but they are just horrible and give off such a weird feeling. The little man just keeps on walking, sometimes the objects don't go where they should go. Edit: Gosh, they are so shameless now that they made an ad saying "oh all these false advertising for other games, but look at ours, there is 0 false advertising in our ads". Lmaoooo

This is a strategy game and was initially really good. Now it is really disappointing. I have been playing for a few months and developing slowly but in the last week it has become really aggressive and you are attacked constantly (even when protected with a bubble). I am giving up because there is no way to progress if you are a smaller/newer player. Wouldn't recommend, it's very frustrating

The puzzles are the best part but there's too much other stuff going on. The advertising is misleading as it implies it is only a puzzle game which is what I wanted. If the puzzles were the main point with the rest of the stuff either gone or perhaps automated as a reward for the puzzles, it'd be a much better game. Right now it feels too unfocussed.

The advert is a lie! Shows just the puzzles which are part of the game but you can only play 5 a day and are a minor part of the game. If you are after a kingdom conquest game then this is what you want. If you want pull the pin puzzles find a different one! Why claim its one type of game when it's another, makes it harder to download a kingdom conquest game! Also after a week or two the puzzles repeat themselves.

As a lot of people have said this game is centered around spending your money and boy do people drop some money in it. The puzzles ar not shoot em ups and are a minor aspect of the game. You can play this game for free without spending but you will find it very difficult to nigh on impossible to compete with others. The game suffers with accounts running bots and people with multiple accounts on one server. All in breach of evony t and c's but evony don't do anything about it. Don't download

nothing like the advert as usual with these mobile games. I don't want to upgrade cities or anything else, I don't want to start a game and the first levels be of no challenge. should be able to jump straight to the deep end. Game is trash and waste of time, didn't get any adverts but I can tell there will be loads of things hidden behind watching them. so there you go you spammed this game as an advert long enough for me to click it, download it, and give it the 1 star review it deserves.

Bunch of liars. They specifically say "don't you wish ads didn't lie?" and then show puzzles only in the ad, which in fact only represent a minor part of the game, maximum 5 a day. So their ad is clearly fraudulent. They give the misleading impression that the game is all puzzles, which it isn't. So as I say, they're a bunch of liars. Avoid. Edit: months later, still advertising nothing but puzzles which is still tiny part of a tedious overall game. Still lying.

Zero stars. Any developer who false advertises their product isn't worth trusting, and their games aren't worth your time and money. They will say elements of the game is true to the advert, but the reality is 99% of it is totally different but they've thrown in terrible puzzles for absolutely no reason to justify the fake adverts. The game itself is a poor version of games like Guns of Glory etc with the usual lagging and begging for you to spend. Avoid them all is my advice.

The game is advertised as a puzzle completion game. That is not the correct game game genre. The puzzle element is just a side aspect most players forget about. This is an empire/army building war strategy game. It is great on that aspect, it does have p2w elements however there's plenty of opportunity to progress without spending, so it is quite fair in that regard. Granted visa warriors will always win.

Advertisement for this game is wrong. Is not about puzzles (they are there for side effect only), this is a strategy game. Also packages are so dear and if you will not buy any, progress will take over decade! Balance is bad as well, if you not aware, you will loose your hard work by seconds. Before download, check first reviews, even trusted sides...

Where are the puzzles like the ones in the ads and not the garbage per bones ones. Advertising did not make me think this game was like final fantasy a new empire. At least you could have added your puzzles shown in the ads but no. You decide to make some new bare bones simple ones. Then again the advert ones don't seem that hard at all. But they could add a good sizeable puzzle count. It's not hard to do.

I don't know why they're obsessed with puzzles when the game barely features any and when it does they're nothing like the ads, they look and play like an old PC game and that's being generous. The majority of the game is a strategy game which begs the point, why not just make a puzzle game if you're that hard pressed on pushing that word in all your marketing. It makes no sense... The dev didn't read my review as I clearly said they do have puzzles, they're just not good and barely feature...

The ads are NOT an accurate representation of the game. This is NOT a puzzle game and the graphics in the puzzles are substantially lower than you are led to believe. If you wish to succeed in this game and not be destroyed every week, you MUST spend a lot of money. Just another pay to win empire building game! Stock response from developer is cringe worthy at best!

Game nothing like adds. This is NOT the shooter or the puzzle game the ads show. Instead it is a city builder. If you want the puzzles you have to play deep into the campaign and spend a lot of money. Deceptive, buyer beware. The game showed in the adverts *might* be there but you have to spend an absolute ton of money to access it.

Pay to win game. Not the scrolling shooter in the ad, this is a slow empire building strategy game. Essentially, pay to protect your empire when you aren't playing. Build up farms and quarries that harvest resources over time, but after a day or two you are constantly plundered by OP players and you have no defense unless you pay to make invulnerable for a few hours. No resources mean you cannot play. The same scales across the whole game.

I was sold on the advert that I had seen but sadly, it just became a confusing mess and nothing I saw in the advert was available, or at least not from scratch. I thought it was going to be level after level of trying to figure out situations but I ended up playing some sort of castle/army building game. I would certainly change the ad to resemble what is actually happening or make it like the advert.

I would give this zero stars if that was an option. The game play does NOT match the advert!!!!!!!!!!!!! The advert even states that this is the game play, solving puzzles!!!!! There is no mention in the advert about building cities and so forth. I mean, I'm sure that during game play one will be able to solve some of the puzzles that are advertised. However, the advert heavily implies that this is all about puzzles. It's definitely not. FFS, complete and utter rubbish.

This entire game is essentially a poorly disguised casino that is supposed to be more acceptable to market towards children. No doubt many other "games" here are the same. This is no more a game than a slot machine, except the prizes here are worthless and intangible. A slot machine where you can only win extra spins, extra spins with increasingly more "epic" fantasy themed images. You don't have to spend money, but that is what the whole thing is built towards. Invest more in spins until...

Pretty Mindnumbing. The adverts lead you to believe this is something else - the fun puzzle element is a very small piece of the game and you have to grind to get there. There are numerous options to spend money and although players can play for free, the process is painfully slow unless you inject cash - and lots of it. If you're blowing this type of money on a game, you probably need to get out more (without your phone). Ironically, I'm only playing this to earn rewards for another game 😅

False advertising. Not a puzzle game, but a very basic strategy/sim game with unsatisfying pvp elements. OK as a casual game, but ultimately boring. Edit: following the developer's reply, I would like to clarify that currently the game is advertised as a puzzle game. Specifically, the advert criticises games that turn out not to be what the advert implies it to be. This is EXACTLY the case with Evony. It is not a puzzle game as being advertised. Change your adverts so they are not lying.

Standard freemium base building rubbish. Don't waste your time. The ads don't match the game. The Devs will respond saying the ad content is in the game, but fail to mention that it is less than 1% of the gameplay. These type of games are designed to prey on you getting addicted to improving your base. You will spend most of your time closing the store to reject the latest "offer" for paid boosts. (Example of the Devs boilerplate response below DONT WASTE YOUR TIME WITH THIS GARBAGE)

Very disappointed as game never loaded properly? It took up space on smartphone and I had to delete other games, so it could play. When I tried to load it, it still crashed again, so had to Uninstalled it. Tried again a few months later and managed to play the first two sort of mini puzzle games! Then the main game stopped and returned to my phone's home screen? Also very slow reaction time and movement on the game. Uninstalled it again. Not worth loading up if you want to wait ages. 😭

I have seen the other reviews and want to sound very grumpy but, the game is very laggy ( on full wifi ) and also I only like the puzzles , I do not really care about anything else . I just thought it was going to be a puzzle game . Not a medieval warfare thing . Like being called " My league." I just dont care about that ! I just like the puzzles . Key notes . Make it into levels of puzzles . Do not play as some king but, just play the puzzles . Make it more animated ( To make it quicker,thx

Like so many, I downloaded this because I wanted to play the puzzle game it clearly presents itself as being. I'm not going to spend ages playing a type of game I don't want to play, or pay money to 'upgrade my keep', before I get to the advertised game. Stop patronising 1* reviewers with rubbish we've already discovered - just don't misadvertise your game! Uninstalled.

Advertised as a puzzle game, but is actually a strategy game with the puzzles as an unlockable minigame. I have entirely no interest in playing a game I don't want to play just to reach a game I do want to play. On top of that, very likely a bunch of my info just got yoinked into some database in China. Don't even install this.

DON'T WASTE YOUR TIME OR MONEY ON THIS GAME!! YOU HAVE BEEN WARNED! I had my account stolen, eventually I got it back but empty of buildings, generals and troops. All I was offered was a few measerly resources that wouldn't even get a single building back to the level it was at before. I tried explaining this and had the offer taken away!! I've spent a lot of money and years on this game to have it all taken away! Game ID 15672433.

It's weird how this game kept being advertised as a puzzle game, when in actuality it's a historical city building roleplaying game. The puzzles are merely minigames that get you items to aide you in building your city. While the special events are creative in motivating you to play, the biggest pain are the raids. There's little to prevent you from being raided by a player with a much higher level, sometimes multiple times in less than an hour, and you have to spend time reviving generals.

This game is a con. 1. The adverts do not feature any part of the game. 2. It has a lot of luck in the game. Most features are spin of a wheel or a random lucky dip. And the % they display for the top rewards never match reality. 3. Many features you need to pay money for. And lots require a large minimum spend. 4. When things go wrong (lag and bugs) Top Games never admit there is a fault and do not help resolve. Even if you send screen shots proving you are right.

Absolutely falsely advertised. The game is completely different and unrelated to the ads and pictures/video Edit: Okay, where is the shooter game where you are on track and have to get levels up by walking through barriers and shooting enemies to progress. It's nowhere in the game, so stop with the outright false advertising. Reporting the app.

Not worth the download. I played the game for the entire tutorial-ish, and it was boring. The only thing that pisses me off was the fact the guy in the ad can't do the simplest of challenges. If you fixed the ad and made the game to be exactly like the ad. Just challenges and not pointless game play. Since you only show the challenges and not the actual gameplay. Might be worth a try actually making the game fun.

Kicked from game and forced to install update on play store during middle of server vs server . Unacceptable , I can not log in after updating and can lose 2 years of growth in 20 seconds because of this. Don't waste your time or money. Thanks a lot Edited to add.. The customer service is absolutely horrendous, the worst of any game I have ever played .. do not waste your time expecting any help or compensation when they mess up , which they do on a regular basis

Nothing wrong with the basic concept but it really throws you in at the deep end and seems ridiculously and needlessly overly complex. Only worth considering if you want to get into a major resources and kingdom building game with loads of complicated screens and clicking in order to get to the actually interesting and interactive game elements which are the bits they use in their ads. As such you expect a casual games as shown in the ads but it takes far too long to wade through all else.

Do not download unless you are willing to throw money away! I have been play this war game (not a puzzle game) for just over 2 years and must warn all new players of the shocking customer service, poor game play and pay to win exploits that Top Games is using. Every week is a new update that costs $2000 and without these you will never be competitive with the top players or battles. If you have any issues in game (which happen daily) do not contact support as they just laugh at you! Disgraceful!

Every time I tried to load the game today it says it can't locate my WiFi. It's locked me out for hours. I am stuck on the gorilla opening page. My WiFi is fine. Not impressed. The game has been glitchy too. Cleared this problem then weeks later.. happened yesterday. I am locked out of the game with no contact details with devs to help. I have spent money on the game...DON'T. You get no back up from developers.

2 stars because the advertisement shown just the puzzles not the other parts of the game, I really did not not like doing the other parts of the games, also the puzzles are to easy well the ones I did maybe they will get harder.. Also the amount of color and options, it was making me hate the game even more as it was like a messy draw trying to find something, in this case trying to find how to get back to doing the puzzles, but it seems you have to do the other parts of the game to continue

Don't be fooled by the screen shots and videos, this game is nothing like it is depicted. About 0.001% of the game is of these puzzles. Even the mystery puzzles are not the same in the game as the video nor are the graphics. This is a very expensive real time poor imitation of Age of Empires rip off with unrealistic goals to get as much micro transactions as possible. Fake deceptive advertising should be sanctioned by Google Play. These guys came under scrutiny in 2009 nothings changed. However the online community is very good for this game.

The game itself is a good time waster, the ads, like most these days, aren't an accurate depiction of the game, you can have fun but beware the server, alliance and people you join, I removed the game after wasting time, money and effort on trying to build a better kingdom but constantly banging my head against the wall, by all means play the game but avoid server 1248, it's a mess right now, also, developers need to add a few more features to the game to better punish or remove trolls and such.

Drawn in by ads where dumb player is always getting killed. I liked the puzzles, so installed it and surprised to find a more involved game. Not into online co-op games so sorry if I keep rejecting your requests to join your alliance and to the two muppets who raided my city... go **** yourselves! Bug in Maya puzzle now I've got to level 15. Rope sticks on side of treasure platform every time so can't proceed. May ditch if not fixed soon! Don't understand the crafting etc. To time consuming

Absolutely pointless game. Unless you are willing to part with you hard earned cash. For faster and better upgrade etc. I came off this game, as reached the pont where I was Attacked for being mid range level. Had to be bubbled/shielded most of the time, when I wasn't, I was Attacked. My advise would be, save you time, do not bother!! I can not rate this game any more that 1 STAR!! Very frustrating and disapointing, that I have waisted my time, playing it for so long. Makers: make it more fair!

Unless you spend big, you ain't competing with the others. Like said in other reviews, you'd have to bot to get the resources you need. The lag during war events is ridiculous. Ruins gameplay. Customer support is virtually nonexistent. You get an automated reply, to which it then doesn't reply after you send your next message. If you're patient enough to keep sending messages, you'll get a human who hasn't got a clue about the game and doesn't read your message properly and ends conversation.

Been playing this game for a few years now and about to walk away. The game idea is great with lots of variety, however lately it's become increasingly frustrating to play. The packs are expensive to purchase and have to spend a huge amount of money to compete, I'm talking £0000s. Evony greed. Unless you spend huge amounts of money it's impossible to battle against the big coiners. The game also has been overrun by bots, loved it at 1st but hate it now because of the bots. Steer clear.

It starts off free to play then if you wanna actually do the puzzles you have to upgrade this that and a load of bull. I'd say the 1st 20-25puzzlea are free. Above that there still free but you will have used all your speed ups by then. Basically a farming game like all the other garbage out there... I want to be able to do the puzzles and that is it, I couldn't give a flying fudge about my castle walls been lvled up nor do I wanna attack other players etc etc, also voices in game r frustrating

What was advertised: fun puzzles. What I wanted: fun puzzles. What I got: some kind of empire building simulator. Even their own advertising says "aren't you fed up with games that aren't what they say they are when you download them?" Yes, Evony, I am: 1 star. Edit after dev response: Your reply is dismissive at best and ridiculous at worst. Why would I bother spending any of my precious free time trying to dig through your "game"? Dishonest marketing and bait and switch tactics. 0 stars.

I did some shooting levels then didn't really understand what to do there after. I could only really see purchases, nothing else worked, and it was actually really quite dull. Sorry 😬 Uninstalled again within about 20-30(?) minutes, I'm a really patient person and I try to give things a good go before I give up on them. I did not enjoy this, even during the shooting.

OK, so. I had seen the in game advert repeated so thought I'd give it a go... Its not whats advertised, add clips show puzzles & that's fine , DL the game and it becomes more like CofC with puzzles. Its intentionally overcomplicated & streamlined towards spending $ for shiny stuff that appears to do nothing . Its just another "invest $ to proceed up the ranks" game. No real gameplay, click & watch bait for bored people with money to burn. It looks good, but that's all. Edit, read the reviews🤨

Honestly I would avoid this game as bullying smaller players and making them struggle for months to do anything. Even if you move out of the way of other players you are still easy pickings being smaller. The game developers really don't care as its a war game. Well it's advertised in the videos as a puzzle game but you need to progress in game to be able to unlock these. The in game bullying is talked about in the message boards by many players getting sick of this. So not wort time!

I just want a puzzle game not a city building game with the odd puzzle. In response to the developers comments, I don't need to be more patience (sic) I didnt buy call of duty then have to play sonic the hedgehog for 4 hours to unlock call of duty, I shouldn't have to install a puzzle game then play a completely different game to unlock the game I actually want to play. Also I've met plenty of people and I hated about 95% of them, why would I want to encounter more of them.

Swarm shooter with some lame building game attached, a decent try at this kind of game but it's playability drops over time with repetition, and it really does become appallingly bad. Still, it's a move in the right direction, one day they'll nail this type of game perfectly and that will be the one we all play, talk about and remember. But that day isn't here and this ain't the one!

Unless you can spend 18 hours per day and thousands in money you will not enjoy this game. Top games do not want you to achieve high levels and be a force within the game without spending on all of their events (several all at the same time). To achieve the highest levels in these events require thousands in money and 2 weeks later you need to do it all again. Game has many glitches and most of the time their updates only make things worse.

I saw the adverts saying the game was exactly like the adverts, heads up, it isn't. There is like a whole other aspect of the game, that is like way complicated, kinda like town/base building, interspersed with completing levels like what you see on the adverts, only its really laggy and way lower quality than the adverts. I wanted a game as depicted in the advert, purely puzzle levels, and uninstalled this low quality game after just an hour.

Nothing like the ad showed. It's a very poorly made sliding puzzle. I paid nothing for this game and I still feel robbed. Edit: the Dev seems to be under the impression that the 'sliding pin' puzzle game is the same as the 'running through barriers' in Thier ads. Don't let them gaslight you into thinking there's more to this terrible game

In order to play the puzzles you need to upgrade your village, so you need to endlessly click on stuff and watch animated dialogue about stuff you don't care about and has nothing at all to do with puzzles but for some reason our hero has to upgrade stuff to play the puzzles which aren't that great, loads of better games out there, give this one a miss

Good Game but issues.. General war game and city game good, but rewards make it painfully slow. 26 days to upgrade your keep the higher your level gets. Puzzles as advertised by youtube, stop working after Level 17, (even when you get to Level 21 and unlock the next few levels of puzzles) "Coming Soon", been waiting 3 weeks now. Definitely a game for persevering and whilst the misses watches coro.

Game is basicly just build up your city, get attacked by someone so much stronger than you that you can't do anything, repair the damage, get attacked again before you are finished. Only way I can see out of the loop is to buy truce arrangements which cost a lot of gems meaning the only way to stop the attacks for long enough is to pay a lot of real money for gems.

Not worthy,I seriously believe that this game is rigged, and the developers are also playing it strategically forcing players to buy in game items, as an example I spent some $$ to acquire content that gave me a general, only for a few days later to be targeted specifically in order to lose this same general, leaving me with the only option to spend more $$ to cover this loss. Not worthy better games out there

Used to be good a few years back, but now the new puzzles make the game so boring 🙄 why did you try to make a strategy game into a puzzle game... Stop it, evony used to be the best strategy game available. Makes me sad... **Update** You clearly didn't read my review... The puzzles are awful, where in my message does it say to add more? take them out 😂 why would you ruin a once great game by adding terrible puzzles, just read your reviews and you'll see what people are actually interested in

You misunderstood me, i don't care about the puzzles, I was playing Evony 11 years before we ever had the puzzles and if they disappear tomorrow it would not change the amount of time i spend on the game. I was just trying to help people with your misleading advertising about evony being a puzzle game. It's a war strategy game with a few puzzles as a bonus. The puzzles take less then a minute and sometimes you wont see any for months.

I'm giving this 2 stars, on the basis that a 1* rating would be unfair since I've only given it ten minutes, but I did hate it. If I played for longer and wanted a MMO game, it may be OK. But... The advertising was for a pin pulling puzzle game, not a strategy / RPG MMO. That annoys me. If you want me to play your game, at least tell me honestly what it actually is. I'm not remotely interested in MMO games any more (been there and done it), so this was a complete waste of time and data. Deleted.

Very fun while it lasted, however if you're like me not interested in proper fights with other players just want to cultivate your city and fight monsters you're pretty much screwed as players who pay money to play will attack you non stop without truce agreement. And what if you run out of your earned truce? Well, you guessed it - you'd have to buy it. So after a third time I got attacked for no other reason but for the players that live and breathe this game to get stronger I just deleted it.

If you are not ready to spend AT LEAST 3000 euro every month, don'd start spending at all. Yes, you can play for free, but all good items is very expensive. Without that you won't have good level castle, lot of troops, dragons, generals, forge equipment and tenths of other items. You will get destroyed repeatedly without spending 30-40k euro every year. Stronger players will kill your troops very easy. Also will plunder resources you have collected long months. Better buy BMW or Mercedes.

Was enjoying it until I realised you had to pay for progress essentially. Also the puzzles stop at an early level (i.e. the thing that was used to advertise the game on various platforms) so it's not great they couldn't even sustain that for very long. Connection issues exist with lag and updates are strange as well and the game would benefit from a guide as there isn't one really. Decent game but loads of issues to fix.

Misleading ads. Came for the puzzles, which do exist, but they aren't the main part of the game and after a while you're waiting considerable time waiting to unlock new puzzles. Edit: never said the ad content didn't exist but they are not the main part of the game. Still misleading.

Let me make it clear for everyone, this is NOT a puzzle game. It begins as advertised, a puzzle game which then turns into build a kingdom shared with other online players. The aim is to build your kingdom and destroy others and this is where the game becomes toxic and evony support never gets back to you when you havr issues. False advertising and lies

Another fake ad showing a puzzle game.... Puzzles may be a small part of this game, but you are launched straight into building and upgrading a city and characters, showing paid options etc. Couldn't be bothered to play much longer, it may be OK but not what was advertised, not what I wanted. Uninstalled.

Tedious pay to win resource "collecting", castle building game. Absolutely nothing like the ads. Stay as far away as possible, complete trash that you've seen a thousand times before with similar games. The puzzles pop up maybe once every 2 days and don't have the level of polish that the ads do - don't believe me? Just check the myriad of YouTube videos calling these charlatans out.

AVOID this garbage! Read blogs and tips tricks thoroughly before starting game first time. Puzzles are only 5% of the game. 40% is purchases. 25% is castle building. 30% is hunting and war. Frequent multiple pop-ups for in game purchases. Takes up huge 2 GB space on device. Switch between 2 screens to play and both are slow to load. Game freezes frequently while playing. Unless you pay money you will be left behind in levels and lose competitions.

Joined for the puzzles, but it's NOT a puzzle game, it's a lame PvP tedious city builder with a v small puzzle sideline, and the puzzles are facile. No, the advertising is not 'a part of the game', it is a TINY part of another PAY TO WIN game which you DO NOT MENTION the city building or PvP garbage AT ALL in your advertising. The ads are gross misrepresentation. You and the influencers who make your ads are dishonest. Bad. Uninstalled.

Evony can be fun initially, then it becomes a grind. Constantly caps event tokens acquired from monsters&resource spots required to progress in said events, forcing you to spend coin in order to complete said events. Pull the pin mini-game is fun but progression is constantly capped requiring you to level up your kingdom, which in turn "may require money". Though the mini game it self, is slow and sluggish with minimal returns for progression. Graphics are not as advertised PS2 era at best.

Man this game is so prolific for jumping on mindless gaming trends to fill it's advertising with that I swear I've seen it shown to be about 30 different puzzle/runner type games over the years. I didn't even recognise it because they changed out all of the pictures every time a new trend pops up to keep a new wave of gullible children installing the app. NEVER EVER trust what this game says it is because it'll never be more than the usual cash-grab base building.

The ads for this game, which seem to be everywhere at the moment, are highly misleading - it shouldn't be allowed. This is NOT a puzzle game, as depicted. Those puzzles are, literally, about 1% of the game - and even then you soon end up repeating the same ones. This is just yet another city-building/alliance war game. If you like those, it's okay. But folks at Evony - PLEASE STOP WITH THE FAKE ADS. Needless to say, I uninstalled it. TG - your response is false. I played it for several weeks.

Not the game shown on video adverts, might be a small aspect of the game but the bulk is a very grindy strategy with pay to win elements. Definitely not for me. Edit: lol nah mate, that's called false advertising. The ENTIRE video trailer shows puzzles that make up less than 1% of gameplay - the other 99% is a P2W asset flip town building strategy that is identical to a million other games on the Play Store. I'm missing nothing...

This is a game where on line abuse, cheating and bullying is rife. High paying players can prevent you from playing the game even if you pay (which you will need to). Evony permit this as these players pay so much. Support is non existent with every ticket not actioned with the same 'we will report it to our development team' response. If you buy a pack and it doesn't appear in you inventory, there is no come back - it is tantamount to theft. How evony are allowed to trade is inexplicable.

I have given it an average review. It is very expensive to play, if you don't pay forget it you won't get anywhere, Firstly. Also forget the puzzles, it isn't what the game is about at all.
